subject: planner: move PhysicalIndexHashJoin related logic into physical op dir (#62843)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, scoped to planner/executor changes. The change is a mechanical refactor: `PhysicalIndexHashJoin` is moved from `pkg/planner/core` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop`, and its cost/Attach2Task hooks are routed via `utilfuncp` function pointers set in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go`. All call sites/type switches (planner enumeration, plan cache rebuild/clone, stringer/flat plan, executor builder) are updated to the new type. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session, concurrency, or compatibility issues found in the moved logic; later upstream history shows continued refactors in this area but no evidence of a post-merge fix required for this change.
